content: Human-labeling session — scout-detect-incoming-army:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, an inbound army is approaching from the east. Base sensors cannot tell which lane it will use, and your west base's latitude varies by seed — a memorised opening will not generalise. You have two jeep scouts and three medium tanks at your west base, on hold-fire orders. Scout the candidate axes, intercept the closing lane. Surface at least four hostile units, destroy at least three, keep at most two losses, within about 28 turns.
